name: Ryouhou ni Kiss no Ame
source:
A very mediocre protagonist was announced at the same time to two students attending the same university on one day. The main character who is tossed by a person who is a twin but has a different color.

[From [url=https://apps.apple.com/app/id1605740664]App Store[/url]]
translation:
某日，同一所大学的两名学生同时宣布了一位非常平庸的主角。被双胞胎但肤色不同的人折腾的主角。

[来自[url=https://apps.apple.com/app/id1605740664]App Store[/url]]
